cases.name: Kozee Montana Featherstone Medicinetop Decorah

cases.narrative: On 5/17/2020, Conservation Officers found her remains, including her skull and rib bones, in a fire which was burning in an outhouse near a remote cabin on the Winnebago Indian Reservation near Winnebago, NE.
